Geographies Served Programs SRTPV Project District Bangalore Bangalore Rural Chikkaballapura Ramanagara State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural Chikkaballapura Ramanagara States Karnataka Installation of 5/7.5KVA Solar Power System. Power up the entire school using Solar Rooftop PV Power System for unhindered electricity supply and need not depend on the Grid, Reduction in Electricity Bills so that the Savings can be used for other purposes. Uninterrupted leanings in school, self-sufficient in energy requirements, use of a renewable source of energy & climate action. ISEIDP District Bangalore Chikkaballapura Ramanagara State Karnataka District Bangalore Chikkaballapura Ramanagara States Karnataka Installation of 5KVA Off Grid Rooftop Solar PV System and Computer Lab. "Uninterrupted Energy Supply for running the Government School thereby making the education experience unhindered and highly effective for both the Students and Teachers, Solar PV Systems have emerged as a Long Term & Cost Effective solution for providing reliable energy, enable computer usage/application exposure to underprivileged students in order to improve their skill set & employability." Preventive School Health Program District Bangalore Bangalore Rural Ramanagara State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural Ramanagara States Karnataka BMI Check, Speech and Hearing evaluation test for 1-4 grades. Facilitate medical intervention for those shortlisted through the pre-screening. Vision care by providing spectacles to the needy students. Impart awareness on health issues, adolescent health, hand-washing, ill effects of tobacco, and tooth brushing techniques. Undertake training for teachers and other staff to carry forward the work. Making available health cards for each child for further referral and treatments. Providing Severe Acute Malnutrition children with Vitamin, Protein and Mineral Supplements. NCDS Project - Initiating ECG Centers & Dental Clinics in PHC District Ramanagara State Karnataka District Ramanagara States Karnataka Initiate ECG Centres in PHC (Primary Health Centres) in order to significantly reduce cardiovascular care disparities and improve community awareness. Uncover the cause of chest pain and chest fluttering. Establishing good oral hygiene and dietary habits have been proven to be essential to achieving and maintaining, overall physical and emotional well-being throughout life. Initiate Oral Health Centres in PHC (Primary Health Centres) in order to significantly reduce Dental care disparities and improve community awareness. Uncover the cause of chest pain and chest fluttering. 2 Dental Chair Unit + Dentist + 1 Assistant + Technician + Medical Supplies + Mobilization for 1 year. A Dental Clinic helps to diagnose and treat individuals with Oral Diseases like Dental Caries, periodontal diseases, tooth loss and oral cancers. In Karnataka, Dental Treatment is not available in PHC's. Facial Deformities Program for Children District Chamrajnagar Chitradurga Raichur Tumkur Koppal Bangalore Bangalore Rural Bijapur Kolar Mandya Gulbarga Bidar Chikkaballapura Ramanagara Yadagiri State Karnataka Telangana District Chamrajnagar Chitradurga Raichur Tumkur Koppal Bangalore Bangalore Rural Bijapur Kolar Mandya Gulbarga Bidar Chikkaballapura Ramanagara Yadagiri States Karnataka Telangana Identify children with facial deformities such as cleft palate, cleft lip through mobilization camps in Taluks and Districts. Screen and treat the children with a team of specialized doctors and surgeons in reputed hospitals in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, India. Community RO Plant & Rainwater Harvesting System District Bangalore Rural Ramanagara State Karnataka District Bangalore Rural Ramanagara States Karnataka Community RO Water Plant Project ensures clean drinking water & promotes good health in the people and prevents water borne diseases. The Rainwater Harvesting System promotes sustainability by reducing the demand for water resources and minimizing the environmental impact of water usage. It also reduces the need for energy-intensive water treatment processes. Safe Drinking Water Project (SDW) District Bangalore Bangalore Rural Chikkaballapura Ramanagara State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural Chikkaballapura Ramanagara States Karnataka SDW Project in Government Schools ensures clean drinking water & promotes good health in children & staff. Reduce water borne diseases and foster healthy living. Clean drinking water is critical to sustain healthy life. Community Outreach Health Program District Bangalore Rural Kolar Chikkaballapura Ramanagara State Karnataka District Bangalore Rural Kolar Chikkaballapura Ramanagara States Karnataka Community outreach programs are an important vehicle for reducing the discovery-delivery disconnect by bringing health education and Health screening services directly to community members. Such programs are consistent with the priority areas for reducing health disparities. Outreach programs are important tools for bringing health education and screening services directly to community members and serve to contribute to reducing health disparities.
